newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Filene's Basement rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Filene's Basement rated buy.

text.p: -- Rauscher Pierce Refsnes said it initiated coverage of Filene's Basement Corp with a buy-market outperform rating.
-- analyst George Sutton said Filene's "is orchestrating a classic retail turnaround, still in the early innings."
-- estimated earnings of $0.30 per share for 1997, $0.41 for 1998, and $0.53 for 1999.

-- said merchandise has been upgraded, and company's complete system upgrade will be completed in June, freeing up future capital expenditures for new store openings and increasing informational and distribution efficiency.
